claims.text: The resort sits at the base of Camelback Mountain in Scottsdale, Arizona, with easy access to hiking, biking and horseback riding trails.

findings.quote: Our luxury resort in Scottsdale, Arizona, sits at the base of Camelback Mountain, with easy access to hiking, biking and horseback riding trails.

claims.text: Rooms have custom decor with Southwest-inspired finishes and a private patio with views of the pool, Camelback Mountain or the Sonoran Valley.

findings.quote: Delight in the splendor of our custom décor with Southwest-inspired finishes and relax on a private patio with scenic views of the pool, Camelback Mountain, or beautiful Sonoran Valley.

claims.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto a private patio or terrace with a daybed.

findings.quote: Towering floor-to-ceiling windows are a portal to your private patio or terrace with a daybed

claims.text: Bedding includes Frette 400-count Italian linens and duvets.

findings.quote: Feel the difference with Frette 400-count Italian linens, cozy duvets, and piles of soft pillows

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a king bed and is a one-bedroom suite that can be converted into a two-bedroom suite.

findings.quote: The suite features a plush king bed and serves as a one-bedroom sanctuary, but can be effortlessly transformed into a two-bedroom retreat

claims.text: The villas have gas fireplaces in the living rooms, floor-to-ceiling stacking glass doors and outdoor patio fire tables with seating.

findings.quote: feature gas fireplaces in the living rooms, floor-to-ceiling stacking glass doors and outdoor patio fire tables with seating.

claims.text: The villas have gourmet kitchens with premium appliances, stocked cookware and an espresso machine.

findings.quote: The Villas boast gourmet kitchens with premium appliances, stocked cookware, and an espresso machine.

claims.text: Canyon Suites guests get complimentary breakfast daily in the Canyon Lounge, which serves wine, beer and cocktails for purchase in the evening with Camelback Mountain views.

findings.quote: Start your day in the Sonoran Desert with complimentary breakfast, offered daily to Canyon Suites guests. Wind down each evening enjoying views of iconic Camelback Mountain with wine, beer and hand-crafted cocktails available for purchase.
Start your day in Scottsdale with a daily, complimentary executive breakfast served in the inviting Canyon Lounge, with Camelback Mountain as a backdrop.

claims.text: Additional amenities include multiple pools, a spa and fitness center, golf, and fine and casual dining.

findings.quote: Additional amenities include multiple pools, a spa and fitness center, golf, and a variety of fine and casual dining options.

claims.text: The Phoenician Golf Club has an 18-hole course for all skill levels with mountain and city views.

findings.quote: The Phoenician Golf Club offers a fair but challenging 18-hole course for all skill levels, complemented by stunning mountain and city views.

claims.text: Activities include specialty dinners, kids' crafts and pool games, mixology classes, bike tours to Old Town Scottsdale and hikes to Camelback Mountain.

findings.quote: Indulge in curated luxury with specialty dinners, kids' crafts and pool games, mixology classes including beer, wine & tequila, and outdoor adventures like bike tours to Old Town Scottsdale and hikes to Camelback Mountain.

claims.text: The hotel is pet-friendly and offers a Canyon Canine Room Service Menu for dogs.

findings.quote: our pet-friendly hotel in Scottsdale, AZ
Guests of the four-legged variety can enjoy a selection from the Canyon Canine Room Service Menu
Canines only w/ signed liability waiver upon check-in

claims.text: The Villas at Canyon Suites are free-standing, single-level villas with valley and golf views.

findings.quote: The Villas at Canyon Suites offer eight free-standing, single-level accommodations with two, three and four-bedroom configurations, each showcasing iconic valley and golf views.

claims.text: Villa guests have private access to an exclusive pool and spa with cabanas, fire-pit seating and full dining service.

findings.quote: The Villas offer private access to an exclusive pool and spa with four cabanas, chaise lounges, fire-pit seating, dining tables, and full dining service.

claims.text: Accommodations have outdoor patios or terraces with daybeds, and private cabanas are available at the infinity pool.

findings.quote: Enjoy refined accommodations with elegant furnishings and outdoor patios or terraces with daybeds, or unwind in a private cabana at the infinity pool

claims.text: Decor and artwork are sourced directly from local creatives and artisans in Scottsdale.

findings.quote: Décor and artwork are directly sourced from local creatives and artisans in Scottsdale, AZ

claims.text: Villa guests get a private golf cart for getting around the resort grounds.

findings.quote: Villas guests enjoy the convenience of a private golf cart, offering effortless transportation throughout the resort grounds.

claims.text: A daily resort fee is charged to each room for a range of amenities.

findings.quote: A daily Resort Fee of $65 will be posted to each guestroom for a variety of amenities.

claims.text: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 9 miles from the hotel.

findings.quote: PHX is located approximately 9.0 Miles from the hotel.
